prompt: The audit log writes whatever detail an entry carries, so a token that passes through a prompt, a URL or a config object lands in the file in plain text, and a single day file can grow without bound. Harden AuditLog in src/bot/audit.ts: stamp every record with a schema version v: 1 beside ts; make sure secrets never reach the file, whatever shape they arrive in — Discord-shaped tokens, Authorization: Bearer values, and env-style DISCORD_TOKEN=, JEV_TOKEN=, TYPESAFE_API_KEY=, OPENROUTER_API_KEY= assignments or api_key/token query parameters appearing anywhere inside the entry, including nested objects and arrays; rotate the day file to <name>.1 once it passes a maxBytes option (with a sensible default) so no file grows without bound; keep the daily file name and keep appending non-fatal, as it is today.
notes: Forward task: no target commit; the grader encodes the stated contract.
